# OpenJoystickDriver

> Expanded LLM context for the macOS userspace gamepad driver. Prefer `llms.txt` when a short index is enough.

The signed app owns the runtime, virtual HID, and authenticated local CLI. Physical HID uses IOHID on macOS 10.15–14 and CoreHID on macOS 15+. Raw USB uses app-side IOUSBHost, or the restricted `com.openjoystickdriver.XboxUSBDevice` DriverKit extension for Apple-entitled Microsoft GIP interfaces.

`OpenJoystickDriverKit` owns parsers, records, HID/USB ports, and policy. It must not import SwifterKit. `OpenJoystickDriverUSB` and `DriverKitGenerator` are the SwifterKit boundaries. `OpenJoystickDriver` composes the app, CLI, and adapters.

Do not edit `Sources/OpenJoystickDriverKit/Resources/Controllers/` or `.build/driverkit/generated/`. Catalog write: `./scripts/ojd catalog regenerate --write`. DriverKit: `./scripts/ojd driverkit generate`. Controller JSON uses decimal numbers. Support status lives in `docs/user/compatibility.md`; do not duplicate it here.

Production and development USBDriverKit personalities match only Apple's approved Microsoft GIP pairs: `045E:02D1`, `045E:02DD`, `045E:02E3`, `045E:02EA`, `045E:0B00`, `045E:0B0A`, `045E:0B12`. Accessible third-party GIP devices such as GameSir G7 SE `3537:1010` stay on direct IOUSBHost. The host user-client allowlist is exactly `com.openjoystickdriver.XboxUSBDevice`. `com.apple.developer.hid.virtual.device` belongs only to the app.

Generator inputs are `ControllerSources.lock.json` and `Resources/ControllerOverrides/`. Schemas are in `Resources/Schemas/`. `CLAUDE.md`, `GEMINI.md`, and `.github/copilot-instructions.md` are symlinks to `AGENTS.md`.

```bash
./scripts/ojd catalog regenerate --check
./scripts/ojd check profiles
./scripts/ojd check schemas
./scripts/ojd check scripts
./scripts/ojd check swift-structure
./scripts/ojd lint
./scripts/ojd check driverkit
swift test
```

Parser/protocol: `./scripts/ojd test parsers-macos14`. Cache: `./scripts/ojd repair swiftpm-module-cache`. Hardware, signing, notarization, and permission behavior need the focused local diagnostics in `docs/testing/` and `scripts/README.md`. Unsigned generation does not prove those facts.
